bounded_unit.finding: Pinned official Cargo documentation states that when Cargo.lock exists, cargo fetch downloads git and registry dependencies so later Cargo commands can run offline unless the lockfile changes. It also documents --offline as preventing network access and restricting resolution to locally downloaded crates, with possible dependency-resolution differences from online mode; --frozen is equivalent to --locked plus --offline.
bounded_unit.phase1_interpretation: This is a useful cache-prefetch/offline-execution pattern but does not itself eliminate the Phase-1 execution dependency. cargo fetch normally performs network acquisition before offline reuse, and later Cargo commands still require an actual Cargo process. Therefore this exact source does not prove a scheduled-Chat-native, zero-residual-executor route.
bounded_unit.verified_scope: Only the body of cargo-fetch.md at the pinned commit/blob and the semantics explicitly documented there for cargo fetch, Cargo.lock, --offline, net.offline, and --frozen.
bounded_unit.not_verified_scope: No Cargo command was executed; no second Cargo documentation path or source was read; no claim is made that dependency caches are complete in any concrete environment, that all builds succeed offline, or that scheduled Chat can execute Cargo directly.
